pages.en: On Saturday, Lily and Dad go to the zoo. First, they see a big lion. The lion is sleeping on a rock.
pages.zh: 星期六，Lily 和爸爸去动物园。他们先看到一头大狮子。狮子正在一块岩石上睡觉。
pages.scene: Lily and Dad standing at a zoo fence, looking at a big lion with a golden mane asleep on a rock.

pages.en: Next, they see a tall giraffe and a grey elephant. The giraffe eats from the top of a tree. The elephant drinks water with its long nose.
pages.zh: 接着，他们看到一只高高的长颈鹿和一头灰色的大象。长颈鹿吃树顶上的叶子，大象用长鼻子喝水。
pages.scene: Inside the zoo: a tall giraffe eating at the top of a tree and a grey elephant drinking from a pool with its trunk, both inside their enclosure; Lily and Dad standing outside a low wooden fence in the front, Lily pointing.

pages.en: Then Lily sees a funny monkey with a banana. "Can I have a banana too?" asks Lily. Dad laughs. "Let's go to the cafe!"
pages.zh: 然后 Lily 看到一只拿着香蕉的滑稽猴子。“我也能吃根香蕉吗？”Lily 问。爸爸笑了：“我们去咖啡馆吧！”
pages.scene: Inside the zoo: a small brown monkey with fur all over, no clothes, hanging by its tail from a branch and eating a yellow banana; below on the path, Lily and Dad looking up at it and laughing.

questions.q: Lily goes to the zoo with Mum.
questions.zh: Lily 和妈妈去了动物园。
